name: 触觉反馈模块
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: single game object cutout, entire object centered with generous margins, three-quarter view, no duplicate views or hands. Subject: One palm-sized haptic feedback module, curved slate-gray polymer pad with small tactile actuators and braided interface cable. Photorealistic painterly concept art for an original cyberpunk neighborhood repair-shop game, non-pixel. Worn dark metal, scratched polymer, subtle cyan accents and warm amber edge light. Crisp readable silhouette and realistic tactile material. No readable text, digits, logos, watermarks or UI. Isolated on a genuinely transparent background, no opaque rectangle, no floor or scenery.
usage: 交易、库存、维修与陈列中的商品图片
